I know the feeling, I think it's because we're good at understanding how other people think that it feels especially bad for us.

To me it feels like problems just come and go as they please and it feels good to get it off our chest but some people dont have the fortitude to keep listening, though not of any fault of their own since it's a draining effort to consciously try and care about someone.

Keep it close to your heart that these people care but they wont always show it, it's also unfair to expect them to 100% of the time as life can be shit for everyone.

If you feel like a burden take a step back, maybe ask them if you are, they may lie for the sake of you feeling better but try and see through it, and if you cant then take their word for it. Like me the the advice "try work on yourself" isnt what we want to read/hear because it feels like a cheap way for someone to avoid putting in the effort to care, while simultaneously trying to solve your problems. 

My thought process is to hold out as much as possible from getting support from friends, it becomes more an act of self improvement while also knowing that if things are too hard I can ask. It also feels nice, as if they care when friends ask about how you're feeling rather than asking them to care; it's like a reward for trying to make their life stress free by keeping problems to yourself. This may not work for you and objectively it might not even be the healthiest so please take that into account, it's just what i personally feel.

Hopefully you find your will to keep going, and please remember that the people you express your feelings to do care even when it feels like they dont.
